title: Cardiovascular risk assessment
what: The doctor estimates how likely a heart attack or stroke is in the coming years. For this, they need your blood pressure, tests, and lifestyle.
why: At preventive check-ups, especially after age 40, and with high blood pressure, high cholesterol, diabetes, smoking, or heart disease in relatives.
duration: a visit usually takes 20 to 30 minutes, and the assessment is given right away or after tests
tell_doctor: Whether you smoke and how much
Whether you have high blood pressure, diabetes, or kidney disease
Whether close relatives had a heart attack or stroke at a young age
Chest pain or shortness of breath during activity

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Cholesterol and blood sugar are often needed. They are usually taken on an empty stomach. Check with the clinic.

prepare.title: Blood pressure
prepare.text: If you measure at home, bring your records for the last days.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Take them as usual. Do not stop them on your own.

bring: Cholesterol and sugar test results, if you have them
steps: The doctor asks about your health, habits, and relatives
Measures blood pressure, height, weight, and waist
Looks at your tests or sends you for them
Calculates the risk with a special score
Explains what can help lower it
feel: If blood is drawn, a short prick
after: You get a plan: diet, activity, quitting smoking, and sometimes medicines
The assessment is usually repeated in a year or sooner, as your doctor says
red_flags: Pressing chest pain lasting more than a few minutes: call emergency services
Sudden weakness in an arm or leg, a drooping face, or trouble speaking: call emergency services

faq.q: If my risk is low, can I do nothing?
faq.a: You still need regular check-ups. Risk changes with age and habits.

faq.q: Do I have to take pills if my risk is high?
faq.a: Your doctor decides. Sometimes changing your lifestyle is enough at first.

reminders.text: Cardiovascular risk assessment tomorrow. If you are having blood drawn, do not eat after dinner, but you may drink water.
